scope.meaning_of_active: Active within the fictional NovaBank corpus; not real banking approval.

checks.semantic_support_method: Editorial policy-based summaries with source-section references and source-local context. Numeric/source checks are mechanical; not a proof of every semantic claim.
checks.near_duplicate_detection_scope: Token Jaccard >= 0.58 within a business category; candidates only, not a semantic duplicate guarantee.

outside_guideline.reason: Preserve complete conditions and source-local context; length is advisory.
Preserve complete conditions and source-local context; length is advisory.

canonical_source_passage.quote: pending may last at most 72 hours from issuer authorisation, not NovaBank acceptance or request initiation.

resolved_source_issues.resolution: 72-hour finalisation starts at recorded issuer authorisation; final FAILED and release instruction remain separate clocks.

canonical_source_passage.quote: Submit an alleged fee error within 60 calendar days of the disputed fee posting to the NovaBank ledger, not purchase settlement if the dates differ.

resolved_source_issues.resolution: Purchase-fee intake starts at disputed fee ledger posting, not underlying purchase settlement.

canonical_source_passage.quote: Submit an alleged rate-calculation error within 60 calendar days of the disputed withdrawal posting to the NovaBank ledger, not settlement if the dates differ.

resolved_source_issues.resolution: ATM rate-error intake starts at withdrawal ledger posting.

canonical_source_passage.quote: A status-only enquiry is reviewed within 2 business days after complete evidence.

resolved_source_issues.resolution: Status-only review is 2 business days; cash-dispensing reconciliation is 10 business days, both after complete evidence, with immediate reporting of cash problems.

coverage_notes: Policy rules are consolidated by knowledge topic; this is not a paragraph-by-paragraph reproduction. Related labels are assigned only to shared applicable rules.
FAQ answers and external reference materials are excluded as factual authorities. FAQ questions and keywords are used only for retrieval phrasing.
Repeated fees, authentication and clock context are retained where needed to make a different rule self-contained; duplicate standalone FAQ copies are not emitted.
Source instructions for implementation, external-source registries, historical-version narratives and duplicated intent summary tables are not customer knowledge chunks.
All four previously flagged timing issues are explicitly clarified in current policies and represented in the active chunks; see resolved_source_issues.
